# shoehorn_marketplace_installation (Resource)

Manages a Shoehorn marketplace item installation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Install a Marketplace item by its slug.
resource "shoehorn_marketplace_installation" "example" {
  slug    = "my-addon"
  enabled = true

  config_json = jsonencode({
    channel = "#platform-alerts"
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `slug` (String) The marketplace item slug. Changing this requires uninstall/reinstall.

### Optional

- `config_json` (String, Sensitive) The addon configuration as a JSON string.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the marketplace item is enabled.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the installation.
- `installed_by` (String) The user who installed the item.
- `kind` (String) The marketplace item kind.
- `sync_status` (String) The synchronization status.
- `updated_at` (String) The last update timestamp.
- `version` (String) The installed version.
